title: The wrong order
starting_code:
# This program does things in the wrong order.
# Find the mistake and fix it!
wizard.move_right(2)
wizard.move_right()
door.open()
wizard.pick_up()
wizard.move_right(3)
hints: Look at when the program tries to pick up the key. Is it before or after it asks the door to `open`?
You must pick up the key as soon as you stand beside it.
Move the action that picks up the key so it comes just before you ask the door to `open`.
intro: One of my old programs is trying to open this door, but it is a bit muddled. It tries to do things in the wrong order.
outro: Excellent! The right steps are only useful when we take them in the right order.
learned: Now you know that the order of the instructions matters, and how to find the one in the wrong place.
